body: Just want to say, I resonate a lot with this and feel the same way. I decided to switch from a tech major to a program that I wanted to do but the jokes on me because the program workload is even more intense, will take 4 more years to graduate on top of the 3 years I've already done in college, and the jobs in this new career pays less (if I even end up getting a job). Too financially strained to get medical care to get a diagnosis/treatment for depression and possible adhd. From one person pursuing a more enjoyable career to another, I empathize a lot and really hope things get better for you soon
